facts_of_case: Parties are staying separately since 2015; daughter born to the couple is with the mother; husband not ready to accept wife back to matrimonial life.

legal_principles.principle: No further union of marital life is possible between the parties when mental cruelty is established.
legal_principles.held: In view of the above we agree with the findings of the learned Judge, Family Court regarding the fact that no further union of the marital life is possible between the parties.

legal_principles.principle: Permanent alimony should be granted in favour of the wife when the minor daughter is staying with her.
legal_principles.held: On the question of permanent alimony, it is seen that despite the wife is staying along with the minor daughter, no separate alimony has been granted in her favour in contravention to the provision under Section 26 of the Hindu Marriage Act.

legal_principles.principle: A minor child's education and marriage prospects should be considered while granting alimony.
legal_principles.held: Taking note of the age of the minor daughter, her studies and marriage prospect we feel it proper to grant a sum of Rs.15 Lakhs to the minor daughter to be payable by the husband-Respondent.

outcome.final_order: Decree of divorce granted, permanent alimony and maintenance for minor daughter directed.

keywords: Latin maxim: 'Nemo dat quod non habet'
